name: CodeGraph
description: Gives coding agents a local, auto-synced code knowledge graph of symbols, callers, and routes across 20+ languages, queried through one MCP tool, a CLI, or a library.

skills.name: Explore Tool
skills.description: Answers how-does-X-work and flow questions in one MCP call, returning relevant symbols' source by file plus call paths between them.

skills.name: Impact Analysis
skills.description: Traces callers, callees, and the full impact radius of a symbol with codegraph callers, callees, and impact before you change it.

skills.name: Affected Test Detection
skills.description: Follows import dependencies from changed files to the test files they affect, for piping git diff output into a test runner in CI.

skills.name: Automatic Index Sync
skills.description: Watches source files with native OS events and re-indexes after a short debounce, flagging pending files so agents never read stale data.
